purpose: The root must reach real C providers, not JS-only exports. This file records the published C interface, the exact per-file migration, and the constraints that keep the cut atomic. Implementing the seam is FIRAcceptance's; the root assembly, ABI wrappers and consumer intake are mine.

currentExports.why: no C step config exists in this tree (no c_step_lower); js_emit_step_lower's providerClosure names no c_* module, so c_emit/c_backend*/c_parts cannot enter the root

publishedCInterface.status: FINAL, published by FIRAcceptance; implementation in work/fir-croot57ab based on 909d651c
rootAdditions: emit_c_modules_start(program: Checked.CheckedProgram, runtime: String, files: List<&2, BIR.SourceFile>) -> CEmit.CEmitterRun<CEmit.EmitResult>
emit_c_library_start(program: Checked.CheckedProgram, exports: List<&2, String>, runtime: String, files: List<&2, BIR.SourceFile>) -> CEmit.CEmitterRun<CEmit.EmitResult>

stepModule.chunk: same opaque typed-native CPS protocol, structural Nat fuel, quantum 64, only cemit_chunk self-recursive, no host-visible stack or request

publishedCInterface.runtimeParameter: runtime: String is the runtime SOURCE BYTES (role of --runtime-c), mandatory and separate from files; it is NOT a path
publishedCInterface.runtimeAuthentication: accepted with one condition: because the runtime is a bare String beside the passive bag, the host reads the declared runtime file (bend2/selfhost/c_runtime.c) and the pass receipt pins its sha256 explicitly; it is not covered by the SourceFile exact-path join and must not be silently defaulted or reconstructed
publishedCInterface.seamInput: full owning CheckedProgram (not reduced FIR); lowers once via BackendLower.lower/lower_library, joins BIR ForeignDeclaration.sources (absolute) to the passive bag by exact path, calls CBackend.emit
publishedCInterface.missingTarget: a missing declared .c target is a compile failure naming the path, never a silent skip
publishedCInterface.wrapperOrder: old ten in current order, then emit_c_modules_start, emit_c_library_start, c_emitter_step

sourceFileCarrier.constraint: single nominal carrier; the C seam imports BIR.SourceFile and MUST NOT declare a duplicate carrier or copy fields
sourceFileCarrier.note: NativeSeed resumes on gate-native branch files; a second carrier there would silently split the contract
